name: Cognor Holding S.A.
summary: Cognor Holding S.A. engages in the wholesale trade of steel products in Poland, the Czech Republic, Germany, and internationally. The company offers flat bars, round rolled peeled bars, slabs, round and square bars, reinforcing bars, billets with rounded edges for forgings, sections, T-profiles, equal and unequal side angles, metal sheets, conventional polygon ingots, carbon and medium-alloy steels, and high-alloy and special steels, as well as products from non-ferrous metals and non-ferrous metal scrap; C-section products; design of steel composition; and bronze, brass, and copper products.
